name: listing.condition
title: Field: listing.condition
description: Meaning of the buyer-visible listing.condition field.
text:
# listing.condition

TL;DR:
- listing.condition is a normalized condition score, not free text.

What it means:
- listing.condition expresses the state of the offered item on the marketplace condition scale.
- Higher values should be treated as better condition.
- Null means the listing does not expose a condition score.

Agent hint:
- Use listing.condition for sorting and filtering by relative quality, not as a substitute for detailed inspection text or images.
